notes.title: [SWITCH RELEASE] 1917DX now on Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278949/ab823bcf5e5f89139f15a85b3ba2dffad98605e6.jpg

Korion and Andrade Games join forces to bring „1917 – The Alien Invasion DX“ to Nintendo Switch this week  

Ludwigsburg, 18 June, 2018 — Korion Games published the release date for the Nintendo Switch version of Andrade Games‘ genre jewel “1917 – The Alien Invasion DX”         
 
A feast for nostalgics and a furious ride for beginners of the genre: The newest rendition of this memorization “Bullet Hell” shooter presents itself in a completely new light on the Nintendo Switch. With special adaptations for the portable system and the addition of a cooperative multiplayer, it also packs a lot more content than the initial release two years ago. "I am glad to see 1917 DX on Nintendo Switch - the ultimate Shoot 'em Up machine.“, developer Sebastian De Andrade says, hinting at the origins of the genre on Nintendo platforms.
All levels come with increasing difficulty and with a boss fight at the end - the heart of the game. Different airships, weapon types and special attacks are necessary to successfully stop the alien invasion. The more numerous the masses of annihilated alien adversaries are, the more glorious the victory is scored.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278949/4057066ee3c7f55025aff3c2c510b6b033cfe955.png

This release on Nintendo Switch is now the definitive edition of the game that both challenges hardcore players and, with the help of the coop mode, also helps beginners entering the genre. "It is a challenging game, but with enough patience and level memorization you will beat it", Andrade emphasizes. The NIntendo Switch version will be available in Europe, Australia and North America on 22 June, 2018.

Andrade Games is an independent developer that is known for classic games in the shooter/platformer genre, that provide a well-designed game experience, unique settings and that put memorable and unusual heroes in the spotlight.

Korion Games is an independent developer and publisher for PC, consoles and mobile platforms. Their strengths lie in strategy games and platformers and in porting games to consoles. Since 2013 the company is active in providing games for entertainment and education and particularly experienced in performance-oriented development in Unity. More info on www.korion.de.

notes.title: [New Game] Top Down Shooter, Release August 11th.
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278949/4e368d20f2401641084d0c5cff526756588a97d9.png

We are proud to announce our new game "SturmFront - The Mutant War: Übel Edition". Its an arcade action game in the vein of Commando, Ikari Warriors and Shock Troopers, mixed with bullet hell elements. You play as an experimental cyborg battle unit fighting against unrelenting mutant hordes to a soundtrack of aggressive heavy metal and psychedelic electronica.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25278949/e02811fd2a46fc6e3552375d1b4e82a4e2d3dbe8.png

SturmFront – The Mutant War: Übel Edition is a remake of Andrade Games’ debut game that aims to enhance every feature imaginable: Doubled content, enhanced gameplay, more graphics and more blood!

This is the ultimate version of SturmFront and a love letter to the arcade genre!

notes.title: [Bugfix] Analog stick issue
notes.notes:
New update (v. 2.3) 

Some of you had the issue that the plane constantly flies to the left. The new update inludes now a small deadzone which should fix the problem. But i was not able to reproduce the bug in my office - everything works fine with my Xbox 360/One controller.

Please give me some feedback if it works now and enjoy blasting some aliens.

Changes (v 2.3):

- new credits (battle painting by Alex Boca and Brunhild painting by Genzoman)
- new deadzone for analog stick

notes.title: [Release] [Free Update] 1917 - The Alien Invasion DX on Steam Dec 16, 2016 *FREE*
notes.notes:
[Release] [Free Update] 1917 - The Alien Invasion DX on Steam Dec 16, 2016 *FREE* 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/470060/

https://otakumaker.com/images/1917DX_capsule_main.png

Update for 1917 - The Alien Invasion Today Friday 16 December 2016 

Launching today, Friday 16th December 2016, a new update for 1917 - The Alien Invasion. 

Andrade Games, independent game developer from Heidelberg, Germany, announces a huge update for shoot'em up 1917 – The Alien Invasion. The new name of the game is now 1917 - The Alien Invasion DX. 

You are playing a weapon scientist, Dr. Brunhield Stahlmüller, who upgraded a WW1 triplane with superior alien technologies to attack the invaders. You will avenge mankind and take the battle into the darkness of space until you reach an ancient alien world. 

FEATURES:

* a bullet hell game 

*3 new planes 

* 3 more levels for a total of 8 ones with an epic final battle 

* free update for those who own 1917 - The Alien Invasion 

* 1917 - The Alien Invasion DX is available on Steam for $4.99

Please restart Steam if the update isn't downloading.

Enjoy!

Thanks you very much to everybody.
Andrade Games & OtakuMaker.com Studio

notes.title: New Version 1.2.4
notes.notes:
We have a small update for you. Important: This is not the big update that will come soon.

Changes:

- New language Italian. ( All Hail to Enzo G Castellari and Dario Argento!!!)
- D-Pad works now for movement without 3rd party software.
- For all arcade stick lovers - you can invert now the Y-Axis. Some of you had  a problem that the movement on the Y-Axis were upside down. This should be fixed now. Or you can fix it in the options :)

- I also fixed an embarrassing typo in the languages. Sorry France ;)
.
